item.title: Lawmakers advance bill expanding Indiana AMBER Alert criteria
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — A legislative panel unanimously advanced a bill to expand Indiana’s AMBER Alert criteria—a move in response to the death of 17-year-old Hailey Buzbee. The Fishers teen vanished in January and was found dead in Ohio earlier this month. Buzbee’s disappearance did not trigger an AMBER Alert because she was initially considered a runaway. “Unspeakable tragedy,” [...]
